response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems expertise with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks explicit executive leadership experience, direct fintech infrastructure background, or a proven track record of scaling engineering teams to the required 30+ people. His agentic AI contributions appear limited to tooling rather than core architecture or production deployment in regulated environments.
strengths: Strong technical depth in distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and real-time data processing (e.g., DLang at Sociomantic, GISCollective platform).
Hands-on experience with AI-agent tooling and frameworks (e.g., MCP code generators at re:cinq), showing familiarity with agentic workflows.
Proven ability to design and maintain complex, scalable systems (e.g., GISCollective, Optilyz pricing platform) with a focus on observability and testing.
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience; current and past roles are primarily individual contributor or senior developer positions.
Limited direct fintech infrastructure experience (e.g., credit systems, payment flows, regulatory compliance) critical for the role.
Agentic AI experience appears peripheral (tooling/frameworks) rather than core architecture or production deployment in high-stakes environments.
